name: Two Six
description: The Two Six (Gangster Two Six) are a Latino Folk Nation street gang founded in 1970 in Little Village (South Lawndale), Chicago. Founding members gathered at 26th and Sawyer, nicknamed "Twenty Sixth Street Boys" by rival Latin Kings and Ridgeway Lords. Alfonso Ayala Jr. formalized the gang in 1977 with black and beige colors; he was killed by Latin Kings in August 1979. David "El Jefe" Ayala led rapid expansion across the southwest side and into Cicero and Berwyn. Convicted in connection with an August 1981 double shooting and sentenced to life in January 1983, Ayala was exonerated and released in December 2023 after 42 years — Illinois's longest wrongful conviction.
